Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions, SOXL and SPAL, for further decay. Monitor the broader market's reaction to rising oil prices and global borrowing costs.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged, decaying positions and respecting stops to protect your capital on margin.
plays: Consider reducing SOXL exposure given its SELL status, -55.68% loss, and leveraged, decaying nature. Protect capital.
Review SPAL's NEW status, -36.82% loss, and leveraged nature. Ensure it aligns with your risk tolerance on margin.
Consider a new buy on NVDA at scanner entry 218.59-218.2 with stop 217.06, driven by the positive AI chip deal news.
